lxc_514f1f167954be98.text: One question will follow you all day: is she tall enough for this ride?

lxc_8b04bdf765975f63.text: You will walk through one real day at the park.

lxc_1af0c0a41cba31cb.text: You will enter on Buena Vista Street, check three rides and their height limits, and eat a popular snack.

lxc_39d072cb8880d9b9.text: Then you will choose Mickey ears and finish with World of Color.

lxc_68e3700988370495.text: You and Hana walk up to the main gate.

lxc_9e1a0304e6a042e7.text: Before you go in, look up.

lxc_4637ff56aba18e4f.text: The gate building has a big, rounded shape.

lxc_f4f6e944a7616a3a.text: It looks like the Pan-Pacific Auditorium, a famous old building.

lxc_ba15b41d9273a23d.text: When the park rebuilt this area, it moved the main gate further out.

lxc_8154f41a0dced72f.text: So the gate now stands in front of a whole new street.

lxc_4529d66736e1c541.text: That street is Buena Vista Street, and it is the first thing you see inside.

lxc_f67b055e5f702f05.text: Hana points to a red car moving slowly down the street.

lxc_eb0fbae83e102245.text: This is the Red Car Trolley, and it runs along Buena Vista Street.

lxc_ee0d38cedb999309.text: She wants to ride it right away.

lxc_da23b9f78ef0f56f.text: First, you want to plan the rides while the morning is still quiet.

lxc_26f92988e024c0f4.text: At 9:00 a.m., you walk into Cars Land.

lxc_002b74850af6999d.text: Radiator Springs Racers comes from the 2006 film Cars.

lxc_2a34fd06c89c02d3.text: Six people sit in one car.

lxc_66bad88d8256208c.text: Your car races another car, and the winner is random.

lxc_c8f4fcebbfddfd94.text: The ride was also very expensive to build.

lxc_c68fbdcb3ca69977.text: It is the most expensive attraction at Disneyland Resort and one of the most expensive in the world.

lxc_dd17d265ea5e941f.text: Before you join the line, check the height sign at the entrance or in the app.

lxc_bdb01c499cd16d07.text: Hana stands next to it to make sure.

lxc_31d472b2d72bf66b.text: At 10:30 a.m., you reach Guardians of the Galaxy – Mission: Breakout!

lxc_2db705272bcc2496.text: Riders must be at least 40 inches (102 cm) tall.

lxc_3837a47b1ba49260.text: But the park warns that this ride has big drops, and it is loud and scary.

lxc_a2ce43c4e1e9a51f.text: The park says it is best for teens and adults.

lxc_ab29ed89fb93f834.text: So you must decide as her parent.

lxc_fd94256cbc48efdf.text: Next comes the Incredicoaster, a fast steel roller coaster.

lxc_8fda4bb4242ce7ce.text: It launches forward instead of slowly climbing up.

lxc_fac0ae60303187b1.text: It is the only coaster at Disneyland Resort that turns riders upside down.

lxc_7dcc5bd43b427968.text: It is also the fastest, at 55 mph (about 89 km/h).

lxc_8da52ca675c73125.text: Riders must be at least 48 inches (122 cm) tall.

lxc_03ccdfa6becbb4e4.text: Lines can be long at busy rides.

lxc_c86024afcd65a140.text: You may also hear the name Lightning Lane.

lxc_4bc0ad4d46be741e.text: Before you pay for anything, open the app.

lxc_e68ff86db02729ab.text: Read what Lightning Lane offers and what it costs on that day.

lxc_243b17036249650e.text: You go to Corn Dog Castle, a snack stand.

lxc_35518f85d6f16f3c.text: Its cheese stick is one of the park's most popular snacks.

lxc_9d0dd49dfe858e6c.text: The park does not print one price for everyone online, so look first.

lxc_300e42584b87e5a5.text: Before you order, check the price on the menu board or in the Disneyland app.

lxc_aea1acf6e76ee979.text: You can also order and pay for food in the app.

lxc_8c38f9e8596fd7ed.text: That can save time when the stand is busy.

lxc_b0f5d0b39e950b72.text: Today you order at the counter so Hana can watch.

lxc_bc9e548c8eacdc3b.text: There are bigger meals in the park too.

lxc_d2c96227114563b3.text: Some guests make dining reservations for a sit-down lunch.

lxc_93e7ba6890fd7b90.text: But for a fast snack between rides, a stand like Corn Dog Castle works well.

lxc_1b1614865e2e4772.text: At 3:00 p.m., you walk into a gift shop.

lxc_603f0ac75bdd9201.text: Hana goes straight to the ear headbands.

lxc_2b334b7774754cdc.text: These are the famous Mickey and Minnie ears.

lxc_9ba625bebf93201e.text: A news report from October 2026 says these headbands now cost about $38.99.

lxc_1aa7e61bb656d09f.text: Before the price increase, they cost $36.99.

lxc_b9a63014c7c7db80.text: That is not cheap, so you think before you buy.

lxc_8598059e29ea52f9.text: Maybe Hana gets one pair, and you take photos of her wearing them.

lxc_d203af015bdacb38.text: For a small gift for her friend at home, look at the price tag on each item.

lxc_6780b8f3cc7ed135.text: The park has character meet and greets with Mickey and others, along with parades and shows.

lxc_b7cbf33861507d3a.text: Before the show, Hana meets Mickey.

lxc_9961eec19df2e6ba.text: She shows him her new ears.

lxc_bae42ba7f6f1259b.text: The big evening show is World of Color.

lxc_db86cc54c8777da4.text: The time can change from day to day, so check it in the Disneyland app.

lxc_a4fd616b9b671a93.text: Hana sits on your lap, tired but excited.

lxc_52314f69669e3536.text: When the show ends, you walk back to the gate.

lxc_d8280162bff45790.text: Buena Vista Street is lit up at night, and Hana is quiet now.

lxc_926b3a8c0ccad1b4.text: You pass the spot where the Red Car Trolley runs.

lxc_63847df2053f12ec.text: You walk out under the big, rounded gate.

lxc_dafa84fa45bcfa0c.text: She is holding your hand again, just like this morning.

lxc_ad11db1a324f49b8.text: You and Hana stand at the entrance to Guardians of the Galaxy – Mission: Breakout!

lxc_e5e4dfc2fdc0609d.text: Your goal is to find out if Hana can ride.

lxc_6dcafeb953a8fd71.text: Learn how scary the ride is and ask about the Incredicoaster before you wait.

lxc_21835bab91604b52.text: You stand at the counter of Corn Dog Castle.

lxc_9c63958496efdc50.text: Your goal is to order two cheese sticks, check the price, pay and finish your order.

lxc_1af2678bf47aa0f2.text: Hana is excited in front of the ear headbands.

lxc_11920faa09ce0037.text: Your goal is to check the price, let Hana try the ears and buy one pair.

lxc_17eed6a1c985a250.text: Tell the story of Hana's day in time order, from the morning to the night.

lxc_ce86319bbc6b95a7.text: Explain which rides Hana could ride and why.

lxc_5e6f7e19ddf37563.text: Your partner is a Cast Member, and you ask about one ride, one snack and one souvenir.
